## swagger-to-sdk

``` yaml $(swagger-to-sdk)
swagger-to-sdk:
  - repo: azure-sdk-for-python

    autorest_options:
      package-version: "1.0.0b2"
      package-name: "azure-mgmt-hasskoo"
```
